svg.title: Prove citation binding and admission
svg.desc: Establish exact citation judgments and a verified admission floor before enabling new proposals.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(96%,97%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;
